title: Dental + Oral Health Chewables
body_html:
Dental + Oral Health Chewables combine carefully selected ingredients to support oral wellness and overall health. Xylitol, a naturally occurring sweetener, is valued for helping maintain a healthy mouth environment. Guava fruit powder adds plant-based nutrients, while microcrystalline hydroxyapatite — a natural component of tooth enamel — provides additional daily support.


This formula also features three probiotic strains — Lactobacillus salivarius, Lactobacillus paracasei, and Lactobacillus acidophilus — which contribute to supporting a healthy microbial balance in the mouth and body. Together, these ingredients create a blend designed to complement an existing oral care routine.*


Taking this supplement is simple: chew one tablet daily after meals, allowing the ingredients to interact with the mouth before swallowing. With natural flavors and a convenient chewable format, it’s easy to make part of your everyday wellness habits.*


Ingredients: Dental Support Blend: Xylitol (Direct Compressible), Guava Fruit Powder (325 mg), 3-Strain Probiotic (Ari): Lactobacillus salivarius LS97, Lactobacillus paracasei LC86, Lactobacillus acidophilus LA85 (20 mg), Microcrystalline Hydroxyapatite Complex (5 mg), Beta-Cyclodextrin, Natural Flavors, Magnesium Stearate.

Manufacturer's country: USA

Product amount (oz/lbs/g): 30 chewables / 0.7oz / 0.04lbs / 19g

Gross weight (oz/lbs/g): 1.28 oz / 0.08 lbs / 36 g

Suggested use: As a dietary supplement, adults chew one (1) tablet daily. Chew thoroughly before swallowing to allow the active ingredients to interact with the mouth and teeth. Do not swallow whole. For best results, use after meals or as directed by a healthcare professional.

CAUTION: Do not exceed recommended dose. Pregnant or nursing mothers, children under the age of 18, and individuals with a known medical condition should consult a physician before using this or any dietary supplement.


*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
